answer: A farm that opens challenges speculatively across many aliases hence burns capital on every one it does not finish. Because the shale deposit is held in the river escrow, the fable audit records each forfeiture and the cost of a failed attempt is fixed rather than optional. Opening a challenge burns a deposit of 84 units that is returned only on a graded submission, so abandoning an attempt is a real loss. A farm of 73 pays that 72 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
